title: Host playbook + tools: mailbox, channel invite, cron, workflow (not raw API dump)
description:
## Wanted product

Every agent turn gets a **short host playbook** plus **real tools** so they know how to: message another agent, manage channel membership, create a scheduled task (cron), create a workflow. Same idea as "ask them to create a job."

## What this is not

Do **not** inject a dump of Portal HTTP routes and tell the model to fetch them. That is how we got fake "I messaged X" icons, no target inbound, and recursive loops.

The inbound spine **is** the request log. Agents never POST /api/chat/... as Jack. Each capability is a **tool**; the host implements it as enqueueInbound / existing BFF create routes.

Do **not** give a writable "stream of all communications." Jack SSE is a view. A2A is mailbox.send then a work item on the target thread (D8).

## Tools (host-owned)

| Tool | Does |
| --- | --- |
| mailbox.send | origin notice + target enqueue source=mailbox |
| channel.add_member | roster grow (lp-k5c4.20) |
| scheduled_task.create | existing POST /api/settings/crons path, as owner |
| workflow.create | existing workflow create path, as owner |

Playbook in the turn system_prompt names **these tools** and when to use them (a page, not an OpenAPI spec). Tool schemas are the contract.

## Recursion

- Fuse: 40/room/hour and ≤8 consecutive a2a without a human (lp-v62i)
- mailbox.send wakes `to` only; never nested startTurn on the caller
- Tools that create jobs/workflows do not immediately re-enter the same turn
- Hop cap / loop_notice stay

## Split

- Platform: playbook text, tool allow-list, BFF handlers, chrome
- lac-r9w: tool runtime on the harness runner (blocks no-tools complete)

## Acceptance

- [ ] Playbook injected on 1:1 and channel turns (not a Settings fixture)
- [ ] All four tools listed above exist and are what the playbook names
- [ ] Jack "message Drift that we're slipping" → mailbox.send, not prose-only
- [ ] Jack "add Drift to #ops" → channel.add_member
- [ ] Jack "every morning ping me the vault index" → scheduled_task.create
- [ ] No agent HTTP client against /api/*
- [ ] Loop test: A mailboxes B mailboxes A stops at cap; no infinite enqueue
acceptance_criteria: Short playbook names mailbox.send, channel.add_member, scheduled_task.create, workflow.create. Host implements them. Model never POSTs /api/*. Jack can ask for message/invite/cron/workflow. A→B→A stops at hop cap. No all-comms writable stream.
close_reason: Done. Branch beads/lp-k5c4-inbound-work-spine-plan 58062dcf. Host playbook HOST_PLAYBOOK injected via host_playbook TurnRequestMetadata on all harness turns (1:1 and group). Tools mailbox.send, channel.add_member, scheduled_task.create, workflow.create as host-owned parsers (no model POST /api/*). Tests wake-policy 19, group-inbound 21, channel-add 17 pass (57 total). Branch pushed.
